entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI recommended an Always-On Sandbox for immediate shared API exploration.
entries.rationale: The team needs immediate read-only API practice in a shared Cisco environment and does not need administrative changes, private isolation, VPN access, or provisioning time.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI recommended a Reservation Sandbox for private administrative configuration testing.
entries.rationale: The scenario requires private access, administrative control, and configuration testing, and the team can accept scheduled access, VPN use, and setup time.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI recommended a Learning Lab for structured beginner practice before independent work.
entries.rationale: A beginner needs guided step-by-step learning content before attempting an independent API activity, so learning content fits better than a sandbox execution environment.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI recommended Cisco Code Exchange to locate reusable automation examples and repositories.
entries.rationale: The developer wants existing Cisco or community code repositories for a network-automation use case before designing a new solution, so Code Exchange is the best match.
